text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The designated meeting spot was a three-star restaurant,
booked solid for the next six months.

text_block_list.name: Floor Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, you're the guest's companion.
Right this way, please."
choice_data_list: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the staff, I headed deeper inside.
Before long, I emerged into a space sectioned off by velvet curtains.

text_block_list.name: Floor Staff
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll be over here.
choice_data_list: Huh! Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Woman in Black
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
We'll need to conduct a quick body check, just to be sure.

text_block_list.name: Woman in Black
text_block_list.text: Beyond this point is the VIP room, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We were greeted by a gold chandelier,
along with a seasoned, heavy wooden table
and a leather sofa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who had been sitting alone on the sofa
begins walking over this way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Right on time♪

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Lady Crown.
How would you like your meal prepared?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Shall we begin?
Now that the Trainer has arrived as well.

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I shall devote myself whole-heartedly to ensuring this occasion is truly worthy of Crown-sama's new beginning.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
Let us promptly discuss our future plans.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"About what starts with tomorrow's training—
the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Not flinching in the slightest in such an opulent place—blending in almost too naturally, in fact—her name is "Satono Crown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The young lady of the world-renowned Satono Group—
...and my Trainee Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Elite"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They are beings expected to win from the moment they are born, even among the Umamusume competing in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This academy brings together elite Umamusume,
including those who carry the blood of distinguished families.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Satono Crown is one of them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Satono Group, a wealthy conglomerate family that deeply loves Umamusume racing culture.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite being an up-and-coming family, their contributions to the racing world
are countless, ranging from charitable works to the development
of new software for the VR Umalator.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"—By now, Satono has become a household name
to everyone involved in the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the Satono family has yet to achieve
the 'greatest contribution to the racing world'
that other prestigious Umamusume bloodlines have."
choice_data_list: "The greatest contribution to the racing world"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is the dearest wish of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "To produce a distinguished Umamusume from our clan capable of winning a G1 race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A GⅠ race.
It is the absolute pinnacle of racing in the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The level of competition in these races is extraordinarily high.
Normally, let alone seizing the pinnacle,
even securing a spot on the starting grid is considered immensely difficult.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There were girls from Satono who earned that right to challenge.
Yet, that wish never came true.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That winter of hardship, too, is coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The day has finally come for me to make my debut!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, with me, I can bring Satono
not just a GⅠ victory, but the absolute greatest honor!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling that cherished wish is merely a prerequisite, a milestone.
What we aim to achieve lies even further beyond!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Satono, who brought forth Satono Crown,
is the pride of the Umamusume world."
I will make everyone inside and outside the industry say that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Neither the blinding light of the past nor the brilliance of a new star
will outshine the radiance illuminating the Satono name.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Because I'm going to become that kind of legendary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
Our car got caught in traffic.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's alright, Dia.
I was just starting to tell Trainer about the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let me introduce her again.
This girl is Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't shown signs of Awakening yet, so her
debut date is undecided, but... she's a promising
star of the Satono Group, just like me!♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to working with you!
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Likewise, I'm counting on you

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Dia is adorable, isn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
However, our resolve is already fully matured.
She and I both share the very same dream we wish to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: We are—the Satono Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When I chose my path, I also decided my wish.
'To bring Satono our first GⅠ victory.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"To become an illustrious Umamusume who shines brilliantly
in the racing culture that Satono loves so dearly."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Satono will spare no effort in supporting you.
We promise our full backing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes myself.
No matter how harsh the training, I'll keep up.
So please—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Satono... Lead me to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Satono Crown is an elite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blessed with a great environment from birth,
carrying those blessings in both mind and body...
choice_data_list: (...She's an Uma Musume who can shoulder everyone's hopes and wishes.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thanks for seeing me off.
And here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Here you go.
choice_data_list: And that is...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We hadn't decided on the distance for your debut race, right?
Think of it as reference material for that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I accept a notebook from her.
Written inside was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ・Buy tail conditioner
choice_data_list: Conditioner...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
This is what I actually wanted to show you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I return the notebook I received earlier
and open the newly offered one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written there was
Satono Crown's performance data by distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 2,000 meters on a sunny day. 1,600 meters in the rain. 2,200 meters when it's cloudy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rather than just data categorized by distance, the notebook contained entries that even factored in weather conditions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...How many times did she run the course all by herself just to gather this information that would be useful for her Trainer?
choice_data_list: (Impressive, she's even backing me up...)
(Impressive, she's even backing me up...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And to a girl like her, I, a rookie Trainer, was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For her, who desires victory with all her heart, how much help can I truly provide?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer?
choice_data_list: (...! No, that's not it.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes myself.
No matter how harsh the training, I'll keep up.
So please—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Satono... Lead me to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am Satono Crown's Trainer now.
There is no way I'm letting her hear me whining like this.
choice_data_list: (It's not about whether you "can"— it's about "doing" it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she's an elite, then I've become 'the Trainer responsible for an elite.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...How is it? Does that data look useful?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's aim for a victory worthy of the Satono name.
Yeah, let's aim for a victory worthy of the Satono name.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: “Mm-hmm! I'm counting on you!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That night, once I returned to my room,
what needed to be done was clear."
choice_data_list: This is valuable data we were given. We have to put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Which distance should we challenge for her debut race? Which GⅠ race would give Satono Crown the advantage?
...There are a mountain of things to consider."
choice_data_list: First, let's rethink tomorrow's training from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that her Twinkle Series
will be brilliant and true to who she is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I need to put a plan together.
So that right from day one, it'll be a perfect day—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —...It's really pouring, isn't it?
choice_data_list: The forecast said it would be sunny, though...
The forecast said it would be sunny, though...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But, well—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: There's not a single reason to be down, right?
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer.
Let us commence training as scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"An obstacle like this is nothing for Satono Crown.
After all, I am—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Because I'm a "heavy track expert"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone could stop her, Satono Crown darts off,
kicking up the rain and mud clinging to her legs
with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That is right.
Heavy rain, foul weather, or anything of the sort...
None of it poses even the slightest threat to her."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Well? Did you get a good sense of my strengths?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even in the pouring rain that paid no heed,
her eyes continued to shine with a brilliant light."
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, very. ...You look really cool.
...Yeah, very much so. ...You look really cool.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu! —Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began our days of taking on challenges alongside Satono Crown,
an elite young lady who ran relentlessly toward victory, even covered in mud!
